company.name: Tipe
company.shortDescription: Tipe is a next generation API-first CMS for developers.
company.description:
Tipe is a tool for developers that takes needless text out of their lives. Tipe generates an API-first CMS from a GraphQL schema with offline prototyping and an inline editor.

The startup makes it easier for developers to navigate code without have to constantly make content edits on the behalf of marketing, by enabling non-developers to make these changes quickly and easily.

productsAndServices.description: An API-first content management system designed for developers to model, manage, and deliver content for Jamstack applications.
